_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Licence policy for what Sangam ships (SANGAM.md X.3, X.3a LIC-1..LIC-11). Used by check_licences.py in CI (licence-check.yml, release.yml).
_comment_conditional: Allowed only for the named components and only under the stated condition.

conditional.condition: LIC-5: separate replaceable jar in /opt/sangam/lib-ext with source offer; never inside the fat jar (checked by --jar)
LIC-8: unmodified, watermark kept visible in modeller and viewer screens

_comment_forbidden: Fails the build when found in what Sangam ships (runtime/compile scope SBOM, npm production deps).
_comment_components: Components that must never ship, whatever their declared licence (purl prefix match).

forbidden_components.rule: LIC-2 Oracle JDBC is customer-supplied (bring your own driver)
LIC-2 Oracle client libraries (ucp, ons, security) are not shipped
LIC-3 IBM Db2 JCC is customer-supplied
LIC-3 IBM Db2 JCC is customer-supplied
LIC-4 MySQL Connector/J is not shipped (use MariaDB Connector/J)
LIC-4 MySQL Connector/J is not shipped
LIC-1 GraalJS (GFTC) is stripped from every build (D-8)
LIC-1 GraalJS (GFTC) is stripped from every build (D-8)
LIC-10 Rhino stays out of the default build (D-8)
LIC-10 Nashorn stays out of the default build (D-8)
LIC-10 Jython stays out of the default build (D-8)
LIC-10 JRuby stays out of the default build (D-8)
LIC-6 legacy AngularJS webapps are not shipped
LIC-6 legacy AngularJS (angular 1.x package) is not shipped

_comment_namespace_bans: Namespaces banned by a downstream programme (purl prefix), with exact group:artifact:version exceptions. Any version or artifact not listed fails; a listed one must carry exactly the stated SPDX licence.

namespace_bans.rule: OneIFMS SD-301 bans org.camunda* at the workflow-engine boundary

_comment_pinned_exceptions: SG-27 owner exception (deploy/licence/SG-27-SD-301-exception.md). Each entry is one exact coordinate. watch=true: any OTHER version of the same group:artifact fails, so a version change must be re-verified and re-listed.

pinned_exceptions.reason: SG-27 owner exception: Operaton DMN FEEL engine
SG-27 owner exception: Operaton DMN FEEL engine (runtime of feel-engine)
SG-27 owner exception: Operaton DMN FEEL engine (parser of feel-engine)
SG-27 owner exception: Operaton DMN FEEL engine (via fastparse)
SG-27 owner exception: Operaton DMN FEEL engine (via fastparse)
SG-27 owner exception: Operaton DMN FEEL engine (JSON values of feel-engine)

_comment_versions: Version ceilings (LIC-7 Liquibase >= 5.0 is FSL until the D-7 legal review).
_comment_jar: Patterns of nested jars forbidden INSIDE the Spring Boot fat jar (BOOT-INF/lib).

forbidden_jar_entries.rule: LIC-5 MariaDB driver must be a separate replaceable jar, not inside the fat jar
